description: This file declares a helper class and functions for adjusting string offsets during UTF-8/UTF-16 conversions, including offset adjustments and merging adjustments.

classes.name: OffsetAdjuster
classes.description: A helper class for adjusting string offsets in response to modifications such as eliminating ranges.

methods.name: AdjustOffsets
methods.description: Adjusts multiple offsets based on a set of adjustments, setting offsets beyond a limit to npos.

methods.name: AdjustOffset
methods.description: Adjusts a single offset based on a set of adjustments.

methods.name: UnadjustOffsets
methods.description: Reverses adjustments on multiple offsets to map from adjusted to original string positions.

methods.name: UnadjustOffset
methods.description: Reverses adjustment on a single offset.

methods.name: MergeSequentialAdjustments
methods.description: Combines two sets of adjustments into one, reflecting sequential modifications.

methods.name: UTF8ToUTF16WithAdjustments
methods.description: Converts UTF-8 to UTF-16 while recording adjustments.

methods.name: UTF8ToUTF16WithAdjustments
methods.description: Converts UTF-8 to UTF-16 with adjustments, overload accepting std::string_view.

methods.name: UTF8ToUTF16AndAdjustOffsets
methods.description: Converts UTF-8 to UTF-16 and adjusts provided offsets accordingly.

methods.name: UTF16ToUTF8AndAdjustOffsets
methods.description: Converts UTF-16 to UTF-8 and adjusts provided offsets accordingly.
